[RLOW.7.3.10] **Each value of the correlation counter is bound once per
firing.** The compiler must lower each value [LCCO.3.7] has a terminal take to
one `FN_GENSYM` (`proto/builtin_fn.proto#BuiltinFn`), bound before the
terminal's first action and in [LCCO.3.7]'s order. Every reader of that
correlation — the call, a continuation's capture fact ([LCCO.5.2]) and its
timeout timer — must read that one binding. A second `FN_GENSYM` for the same
correlation would give one activation two correlations, and its siblings would
join neither.
